Sophie (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Meridian onboarding. Quick sync: stakeholders, success criteria, and a 10-day milestone plan. Who's in for a brief stand at 11?
Arjun (Eng): +1, can do 11. need to know expected API rps and sample payload sizes.
Tom (Client - Meridian): 11 works. FYI initial scope: chat + embeddings. Avg reqs ~ 8 req/min, spikes to ~120 for 10-15m during business hours. Payloads up to ~2KB.
Lena (Product): I'll join — want to confirm success criteria from product side: 95% uptime, p95 latency < 200ms for short prompts, and embedding accuracy within our eval set baseline.
Sophie (CSM): Great — capture those. Priya, can you draft a 10-day milestones checklist we can share with Meridian?
Priya (Success Ops): On it. Draft below, share for edits: 1) Day 0: Kickoff + stakeholder roster. 2) Day 1-2: Provisioning & API keys (Private/Dedicated decision). 3) Day 3-4: Test harness + sample traffic. 4) Day 5-7: Load tuning & latency SLO tuning. 5) Day 8-9: Sandbox rollout + sign-off tests. 6) Day 10: Production switch & 72h monitoring window.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Two quick asks: who will own network/VPC details on Meridian side? And do they need on-prem?
Tom (Client - Meridian): Meredith (VP Eng) will own network. No on-prem initially — VPC peering preferred. We'll loop in infra team during the provisioning step.
Arjun (Eng): For the load tuning step, recommend we start with quantized model variant Q4 (low-cost) and fallback to full fp16 for high-priority routes. I'll prepare an autoscaling policy proposal.
Sophie (CSM): Noted. Lena — can your team provide the embedding eval set by EOD today? We'll attach to the quality gating.
Lena (Product): Yes, sending a link to the eval set in a follow-up message. Expect some baseline metrics too.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: add meeting to calendar — /schedule Meridian onboarding stand 11:00 AM PT (link: https://cal.redwood/meet/meridian-onboard).
Priya (Success Ops): Flagging renewal risk: Meridian's contract renewal in 11 months. If onboarding stalls >30 days, escalate to AM and Sales Ops. Logging that as a low->medium risk now.
Sophie (CSM): Good call. We'll put a cadence: twice-weekly check-ins for first 2 weeks, then weekly. Who is OK owning the twice-weekly recap notes?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can own the tech recap notes for the first 2 weeks.
Tom (Client - Meridian): Meredith will own internal Meridian action items; I will share their contact shortly.
Arjun (Eng): Quick config snippet I'm proposing for the test harness (shared here so ops can validate):
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Body: {"model":"redwood-q4","prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":256}
```
Keep concurrency at 8 for initial smoke tests.
Sophie (CSM): Love it. Action items so far: 1) Priya: finalize 10-day checklist + share Asana task. 2) Arjun: autoscale + quantization proposal by EOD. 3) Ravi: tech recap ownership. 4) Lena: eval set + baselines. 5) Tom: Meridian network contact. I'll send calendar invite and stakeholder roster after the 11am stand.
Lena (Product): Also adding a quality gate: embedding cosine threshold >= 0.82 for the eval set. If below, we pause production rollout and raise to product/eng for triage.
Priya (Success Ops): Adding that to the checklist. Also adding an enablement session for Meridian devs on Day 4 (30m).
Tom (Client - Meridian): Sounds good. Appreciate the clarity — look forward to the stand.
Sophie (CSM): Thanks everyone. Quick note: if anyone hits blockers before 11, ping me directly. Otherwise see you at the stand. :rocket:
